items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he played with Joe Oliver. I know some people say, he was an Ory... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. I think he stayed, Ory. Oh yeah, he been dead long ago.

ctx.x: Well, he used to play with, uh, Bob and I. Yeah, he played with Joe Oliver. I know some people say, he was an Ory, I think for a while. Yeah, he's one of the more times than me. You were supposed to be our best drummer we had, yeah. I've heard that he was very good, yeah.
Yeah. I think he stayed, Ory. Oh yeah, he been dead long ago. Mm.
